steps.text: After restarting Anubis with the same installation and port, sign in with the same token. Click [[control:Cases]]. Locate [[value:Nacre Customer Portal manual installation test]] and confirm its completed status. Click [[control:View engagement]].
Open [[control:Saved deliverables]]. The completed engagement and its downloads remain available after restart. Click [[control:Download complete engagement record]] to retrieve the saved version.

Click [[control:Explain this to me]] on the completed version. The saved deterministic explanation appears without generating another result. Expand [[control:Previously saved explanations]] to see its history.
Read the saved network requirements and next steps. Click [[control:Download explanation]] to retrieve this exact saved interpretation, then close the panel.
